correctness.rationale: For fixed x!=y, leaf-twin event requires f(x)=f(y) in n-2 other positions, all other function values avoid x,y, and colors agree, yielding E X=choose(n,2)*(n-2)/n²*(1-2/n)^(n-2)/q. For r ordered vertex-disjoint pairs, exact factorial-moment expression (n)_(2r)/(2^r q^r)*(n-2r)^r/n^(2r)*(1-2r/n)^(n-2r) tends lambda^r. Any overlap edge-configuration with v vertices in c nontrivial components costs O(n^{2c-v})=O(1/n) when not a perfect matching. Thus X=>Poisson(lambda). A nontrivial permutation of cyclic vertices must rotate a cycle or align distinct cycles; expected compatible candidates O(sqrt(n)/q+log(n)/q)=o(1). A moved non-leaf at smallest depth above fixed cycles forces an equal-color pair of sibling non-leaves with equal-color children, a four-vertex witness with expected count <=(n)_4/(n³q²)=O(n/q²)=o(1). Leaf-twin swaps are actual automorphisms; all other symmetries vanish. Independent exact brute force enumerated 729 uniform maps/colorings at n=3,q=3 and recovered E twins=1/27, checking every automorphism; the argument for the limit remains analytic.
